decisions.statement: The manifest is written from the values the addon's own manifest declares.
The Lua the manifest names is the bundle the compiler settings declare.
An addon folder with no compiler settings has settings written before the bundle is read.
The catalog addon alone takes its api version from the catalog domain pages.
That version is the lowest any domain being collected last ran a generator for.
A catalog domain left alone counts toward no version.
A domain being collected that states no version refuses the call.
The catalog version is as current as the last rebuild of the index.
A dependency floor of zero is written as the bare addon name.
The build stamp is the first eight hex of the commit the addon folder is at.
An addon name that is no bare folder name refuses the call before Lua is written.
A stamp the environment names holds over the commit.
Markup is listed only where the addon holds that markup.
A file the manifest lists is listed once.
Keybinds are listed wherever the addon's page carries a keybinds file.
Where a file the manifest lists sits is settled by one rule, held elsewhere.
Each file written here is named to the caller as soon as that file is written.

definition: the manifest the game reads to decide what an addon loads and in what order
